verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live model catalog. The models page [groq-docs-3] is static documentation describing individual models, not a programmatic listing endpoint. General OpenAI compatibility via base_url [groq-docs-2, groq-docs-33] is described only as 'mostly compatible', so a models-list route cannot be inferred from it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
